note: Append-only decision ledger. Lines with type _meta are documentation and may be skipped by consumers. All other lines are decision records. These seed records preserve the governing decisions supplied at LS0; no new strategy is authored here.

title: Create Learning Spine LS0 scaffolding
decision: Stand up the scalesignals-learning-spine repository as a read-only governance and memory layer (markdown/YAML/NDJSON only).
reasoning: Externalise decisions, state and rules to preserve memory and gradually reduce manual coordination, without enabling any execution.

title: Keep ScaleSignals and Vantage separate
decision: ScaleSignals (founder-facing) and Vantage (institutional-facing) remain separate products with separate data; no merging.
reasoning: Founder-private material must not become investor-side intelligence; protects founder trust and the core promise.

title: ScaleSignals first-value definition for the Apius pilot
decision: First-value = one credible company source; evidence-grounded interpretation; three credible SA/Africa-relevant healthcare capital providers or pathways; transparent evidence and uncertainty; at least one safe serious next action; no provider contact; no unsupported fit claim.
reasoning: Defines a conservative, trust-first proof bar for the controlled pilot.

title: HAVAÍC as likely priority action route (pending validation)
decision: Treat HAVAÍC as the likely priority private/action route for Apius, PENDING controlled validation. Proposed, not approved.
reasoning: Best current candidate direction subject to validation; no contact and no fit claim implied.

title: AAIC Africa Healthcare Fund route unclear
decision: Record AAIC Africa Healthcare Fund as a relevant candidate whose public capital intake route is unclear; confidence capped pending route clarity.
reasoning: Relevance is plausible but the intake route is not established; uncertainty must be stated.

title: IDC Chemicals, Medical & Industrial Mineral Products SBU is conditional only
decision: IDC CMIMP SBU is conditional only; official route visibility does not make it commercially preferable. Funding criteria, likely friction, funding amount, use of funds and evidence burden must be assessed before any promotion.
reasoning: Visible route is not evidence of value; requires assessment.

title: Green Rock excluded for Apius on current evidence
decision: Green Rock is not appropriate for Apius on current accepted evidence because its supported geography is Brazil/Latin America rather than South Africa.
reasoning: Evidenced geography mismatch; recorded as a negative finding with full rigour.

title: No autonomous execution in LS0
decision: This repository enables no execution, automation, data ingestion, API/model orchestration, or telemetry; AI may read and draft only.
reasoning: Conservative, approval-gated posture; Ben remains the approver.
